_comment: 朝礼ページ（content/articles/asakai_lecture.json）の 絵 14枚。2026-09-14 の 本文差し替えで 作り直し。文字を 焼く ので noText は asakai_zukai と 同じ 文を 逐語で 使う。新人（名前の 無い 架空の 人）は 1枚目を 絵柄アンカーに して 顔を そろえる。台帳が 正で、教材JSONの prompt は その 写し（scripts/lib/image_ledger.mjs）。
style: Warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, flat cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. A tidy contemporary Japanese software office with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions, warm friendly faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME. This is a TEACHING picture, not a mood picture: what each person is doing must be readable from the picture alone.
noText: Japanese lettering — read this part carefully. The picture contains ONLY the Japanese words listed in the scene above, and no other writing at all. Print each word LARGE and horizontally in a rounded gothic Japanese font, with generous space around it. Directly above every kanji, print its reading in small hiragana (furigana), centred over that kanji, clearly separated from it, at about 45% of the kanji height, so that the kanji and the furigana both stay sharp and easy to read at a glance. Words written only in hiragana or katakana take no furigana. Spell every character exactly as given. No other letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the picture.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry or crying faces, watermarks, real company logos or brand marks of any kind, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, tiny cluttered text, paragraphs of text, 3D render, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, robots, mascots.

scenes.title: 朝9時の 朝礼（表紙）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: it is about nine in the morning, and a small software team gathers to talk before starting work. A bright Japanese IT office in the morning, rows of desks with computers and monitors behind the team. Four colleagues stand in a loose circle beside the desks: the team leader Hendy — a slim man in his late twenties with short black slightly tousled hair, a navy two-button suit, a white shirt and a navy tie (follow his model sheet) stands at the left, facing the others, opening the meeting with a small friendly nod; the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card stands at the right, bowing her head slightly and greeting him back with a smile; Okuda — a man in his mid twenties with wavy messy black hair, black thick-rimmed glasses and a dark green hoodie (follow his model sheet) and Nyam — a Southeast Asian man in his twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair swept up and back, and a coral knit cardigan over a cream shirt (follow his model sheet) stand between them, holding mugs and small notebooks, listening. Morning sunlight through a big window. Hendy has one rounded speech balloon that says: おはようございます。朝礼を 始めます。 The new engineer has one smaller speech balloon that says: おはようございます。 Wide shot filling the frame.
text: おはようございます。朝礼を 始めます。

scenes.title: 短い 報告（9:00 朝礼 → 9:10 仕事スタート）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: the morning meeting is a short report before work, not a long meeting. A bright office in the morning. the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card stands and speaks briefly, holding a small notebook, while the team leader Hendy — a slim man in his late twenties with short black slightly tousled hair, a navy two-button suit, a white shirt and a navy tie (follow his model sheet), Okuda — a man in his mid twenties with wavy messy black hair, black thick-rimmed glasses and a dark green hoodie (follow his model sheet) and Nyam — a Southeast Asian man in his twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair swept up and back, and a coral knit cardigan over a cream shirt (follow his model sheet) stand around her and listen with calm nods. Everyone is standing, nobody sits, there is no meeting table — it is quick. In the top right corner, a small cream note panel shows a tiny schedule in two lines with a small downward arrow between them: the first line reads 9:00 朝礼 and the second line reads 9:10 仕事 スタート.

scenes.title: ① きのう したこと（ログイン画面を 作る）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: yesterday she built the login screen. Close view of the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card sitting at her desk, typing on a keyboard while looking at a large monitor. The monitor shows a simple login screen being built: two empty input boxes and one rounded button, with the word ログイン in large letters above them. Calm, focused expression.

scenes.title: ② 進捗（ログイン機能 70%）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: the whole login feature is 70 percent done. Close view of a large monitor on a desk showing a clean progress screen: the label ログイン機能 at the top, and below it one thick horizontal progress bar filled with sky blue up to 70 percent, with 70% printed large at the end of the filled part. the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card sits beside the monitor and points at the bar with a small confident smile.

scenes.title: ③ きょう すること（To Do の API接続）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: today's task is connecting the API. A team task board on the office wall with three columns of sticky notes. The heading of the left column reads To Do. In that column one large yellow sticky note clearly reads API接続. All the other sticky notes are blank. the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card stands in front of the board and touches the API接続 note, ready to start.

scenes.title: ④ 問題（エラーで 困る）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: an error appeared and she is stuck. Close view of the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card at her desk looking at her monitor with a puzzled, worried face, one hand on her cheek. The monitor shows a soft red error window with a round warning mark and the word エラー printed large. Not scary — just a small problem at work.

Two panels side by side. LEFT PANEL: the four-person morning meeting standing in a circle: the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card speaks, and her short speech balloon says APIの 接続で エラーが あります。 while the team leader Hendy — a slim man in his late twenties with short black slightly tousled hair, a navy two-button suit, a white shirt and a navy tie (follow his model sheet), Okuda — a man in his mid twenties with wavy messy black hair, black thick-rimmed glasses and a dark green hoodie (follow his model sheet) and Nyam — a Southeast Asian man in his twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair swept up and back, and a coral knit cardigan over a cream shirt (follow his model sheet) listen. RIGHT PANEL: after the meeting, only the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card and the team leader Hendy — a slim man in his late twenties with short black slightly tousled hair, a navy two-button suit, a white shirt and a navy tie (follow his model sheet) sit side by side at her desk, both looking at her monitor together; the other two have gone back to their own desks in the background.
